name: shriek
desc:
When bright light or a creature is within 30 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, it emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of it. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} continues to shriek until the disturbance moves out of range and for 1d4 of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns afterward
